limits.durationTierNote: BGM 与环境声选「标准」，sting 选「短版」；标准版实际长度每次不同，按 4 小节整数倍裁

prompts.promptEn: Cozy acoustic instrumental loop for a home-renovation game. 72 BPM, 4/4, warm key of C major. Fingerpicked steel-string acoustic guitar plays a gentle I-V-vi-IV arpeggio; soft upright piano adds sparse single notes high in the register; light shaker on eighth notes; brushed upright bass on root and fifth. Late-afternoon sunlight in an old wooden house - intimate, unhurried, a little nostalgic, never sad. Steady repeating texture, no lead melody, no build-ups, no fills. Dry and close, small room reverb, no brightness, no harshness. Instrumental only, no vocals. Start straight on the pattern and keep the same energy to the very last second: no intro, no outro, no final cadence, no fade-out.
prompts.promptZh: 家用修缮游戏的温馨原声循环。72 BPM，4/4，C 大调。钢弦木吉他分解和弦 I–V–vi–IV，立式钢琴在高音区点稀疏单音，沙锤走八分，擦弦贝斯根音加五度。旧木屋下午的阳光：亲密、不着急、有点怀旧但不明亮伤感。织体稳定重复，不要主旋律、不要推进、不要加花。干声、近场、小房间混响，不刺耳。纯器乐，无人声。一上来就是织体，到最后同样力度：不要前奏、不要尾奏、不要终止式、不要淡出。
prompts.note: 循环 20 次以上不烦，故意不要旋律；挑最不像一首歌的一版

prompts.promptEn: Quiet late-night instrumental for the attic chapter of a story game. 60 BPM, 4/4, A minor with a warm major lift. Felt piano plays slow sparse chords with long sustain; a low string pad of cello and viola holds underneath; faint rain on a window and soft room tone, no thunder. Intimate, melancholic but safe - like sitting on the floor under a bare bulb. No percussion, no melody hook, no swells that resolve. Very soft dynamics, wide natural reverb. Instrumental, no vocals. No intro, no outro, no fade-out; keep it even from start to finish.
prompts.promptZh: 剧情游戏阁楼章节的安静夜景。60 BPM，4/4，a 小调，偶尔抬到明亮的大三和弦。毡化钢琴慢慢地弹稀疏和弦、长延音；低音弦乐垫（大提琴 + 中提琴）在下面托着；窗外有很轻的雨和房间底噪，不打雷。亲密、忧郁但安全——像坐在裸灯泡下的地板上。没有打击乐、没有旋律钩子、没有「解决式」的渐强。动态很轻，宽的自然混响。纯器乐，无人声。不要前奏、不要尾奏、不要淡出，从头到尾一样平。
prompts.note: 60 BPM 下 20 小节正好 80s，与 15 的设计值一致

prompts.promptEn: Minimal title-screen instrumental. 56 BPM, sparse solo piano, single notes with long pedal decay in a large empty room; one soft low drone; faint wooden creaks and birds far outside a window. Wistful and still, a lot of silence between notes. Instrumental, no vocals, no drums, no melody development. No intro or outro, no fade-out, one quiet level throughout.
prompts.promptZh: 极简启动画面。56 BPM，独奏钢琴，单音、长踏板、大而空的房间；一条很轻的低音持续音；远处木头吱呀和窗外的鸟。怅然、静止，音符之间留很多空白。纯器乐，无人声，无鼓，不做旋律发展。不要前奏尾奏、不要淡出，全程一个音量。
prompts.note: 40s = 9.33 小节，取 8 小节 34.3s；要长一点取 12 小节 51.4s

prompts.promptEn: Three-note ascending chime: soft glockenspiel with a small bell shimmer, notes rising step by step, each with a quick natural decay, warm and hopeful, finished within three seconds. No music bed, no drums, instrumental.
prompts.promptZh: 三音上行的钟琴：柔和的钟琴带一点铃的泛音，逐级上行，每个音自然快速衰减，温暖、有希望，三秒内结束。不要伴奏铺底，不要鼓，纯器乐。
prompts.note: 只截最后 3 秒；做不出来就用 3 个单音自己拼

prompts.promptEn: A twelve-second closing cue. Solo piano states a simple four-note motif, a soft string swell joins underneath, resolving on a warm major chord with a long natural reverb tail. Tender, final, like closing the door on a good summer. Instrumental, no vocals, no drums.
prompts.promptZh: 十二秒的收尾。钢琴独奏一个四音动机，低音弦乐在下面慢慢铺开，最后落在温暖的大三和弦上，留长自然混响尾巴。温柔、终章感，像给一个好夏天关上门。纯器乐，无人声，无鼓。
prompts.note: 与 bgm_day 用同一套乐器描述，结尾才像同一部作品

prompts.promptEn: Field-recording ambience: steady medium rain on a wooden porch roof, water dripping from the eaves, wet leaves moving, no thunder, no music, no voices, no birds. Continuous even texture, loopable.
prompts.promptZh: 实景录音式的环境声：中等强度的雨打在木头门廊顶上，屋檐滴水，湿叶子在动。不要雷、不要音乐、不要人声、不要鸟。质地连续均匀，可循环。
prompts.note: 游戏里音量压得很低，实测按 -24 LUFS 附近给

prompts.promptEn: Morning courtyard ambience: sparrows chirping and one distant collared dove, light breeze in leaves, very faint far-off street noise, no music, no voices, no rain. Gentle, consistent, loopable.
prompts.promptZh: 清晨院子的环境声：麻雀叽喳，远处一只斑鸠，树叶间有微风，极轻的远处街道声。不要音乐、不要人声、不要雨。温和、均匀、可循环。
prompts.note: D16–D18 院子；鸟叫密度别太高，会抢订单音
